Name: Horse Fast Travel
Author: EliteWise
Description:
[b]Horse Fast Travel[/b] lets you travel from your farm’s stable to Pierre’s General Store on your own horse.
Interact with your stable, choose the travel option, and enjoy a short ride before arriving outside Pierre’s. Trips cost [b]1,000g[/b] by default, and both the price and animation duration are configurable.
[list]
[*]Uses your existing horse.[/*]
[*]Cancel during the riding animation with [b]Escape[/b] or controller [b]B[/b] for a refund.[/*]
[*]Available in [b]English and French[/b], matching your game’s language.[/*]
[/list]Requires a completed stable and a named horse. Travel is one-way and unavailable on festival days. Pierre’s opening hours remain unchanged.
